text_block_list.text:
While making final adjustments for the 
live performance together with Light 
Hello—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-saaann! Ms. Hello, the lyrics are 
finished!
choice_data_list: Really? Tell me all about it!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no no no! I want you to save listening 
to it for the real performance!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it turned out to be such an 
incredible song! Count down the days and 
look forward to hearing it, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, too bad, Trainer. Looks like I'll be 
the only one checking it...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Hello-san, you shouldn't be 
listening either!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because this is a song from us to everyone 
who supported us, after all.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
If we want to put it in the program, we'll 
need a title for the song...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you two should figure that out 
together, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
As a gift from the two who have always 
stayed by our side to us!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to seeing what the 
title will be!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, what should we do? Asking us to 
title it without even seeing the lyrics...
choice_data_list: Shall we think it over together?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's true. Fortunately, we have 
plenty of time.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: The words we want to dedicate to them—
